instruments.name: Tack Upright
instruments.source: GM Honky-tonk piano (detuned tack-upright character), note-per-note mp3 renders from the MIDI-JS Soundfonts collection (github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts), bundled from npm web-music-score-samples/003-honkytonk-piano. The collection is rendered from the FluidR3_GM / MusyngKite / FatBoy banks; the packaging does not identify the exact bank.
